data: Which of the following reaches the highest cosine similarity at version 50,000?

The caption states that as the model trained, the cosine similarity measure grew for functionally similar pairings. The figure shows multiple lines representing different pairs of actions, each with its own color. At version 50,000, the line representing the pair "item_magic_stick & item_magic_wand" appears to reach the highest cosine similarity value among all the lines shown in the figure. Therefore, the answer is "item_magic_stick & item_magic_wand".
